title.romaji: Rock wa Lady no Tashinami Deshite
title.native: ロックは淑女の嗜みでして

synonyms: Rock wa Shukujo no Tashinami de shite
description:
At an elite all-girls' academy where refined young ladies gather, Lilisa Suzunomiya, now the daughter of a real estate tycoon after her mother remarried, is forced to abandon her guitar and rock music to fit in. However, her passion is reignited by sounds from the old school building, where she meets a skilled drummer who shares her love for rock. Together, they embrace their inner rockstars, elegantly clashing and shouting their way through the academy in this captivating tale of grace and rebellion.

(Source: HIDIVE)

node.description: Beautiful and well mannered, she is the daughter of Kijuro Kurogane of the Kurogane family, which has produced many prime ministers since the Meiji era and whose influence extends to politics and business. She is a drummer.

Lilisa was formerly from a commoner background. [Her mother](https://anilist.co/character/366741/Yuka-Suzunomiya) remarried Suzunomiya Tadashi, a real estate magnate in Kanto. She hides the fact that she was from a commoner background who liked rock and guitar only a month ago, and pretends to be a first-class lady, becoming the object of envy at school.

Tina is a 2nd year student at Oushin Girls' Academy. She's referred to as Oushin's Prince due to her tall and androgynous appearance. In actuality, she has low self confidence and acts the way other people want her to be, and she wants to change that about herself.

Tamaki is a 2nd year student at a sister school to Oushin Girls' Academy. She's well known as a skilled guitarist in her local area and repeatedly refuses offers to join bands. She is also [Otoha's](https://anilist.co/character/344565/Otoha-Kurogane) childhood friend.
[Hiyori's](https://anilist.co/character/367165/) private tutor and twin to [the euphonium player](https://anilist.co/character/367169/) in 'Red Familia'.
A former "Noble Maiden" at Sakuragokoro Girls' Academy.
